Chief_Complaint.content: Patient reports feeling unwell for the past four days with symptoms including a sore throat, runny nose, and cough.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: I've been feeling kind of uh under the weather for the past four days... it started with the um, uh sore throat and runny nose, and... it's sort of going into a cough now.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Symptoms began four days ago, possibly after exposure to a sneezing colleague.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it all started with, uh, this colleague of mine, she just kept sneezing next to me

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The sore throat was initially painful on swallowing but is now improving.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it was quite painful to swallow, for one or two days... the sort throat is kind of going away

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has a runny nose with clear discharge and feels congested.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it's uh it's clearing up... Sort of getting my nose stuffed all the time... Yeah, quite congested.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: A dry, constant cough started yesterday.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: that started recently, like just uh um maybe yesterday. And um it's uh, it's dry for now... it's sort of constant.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has been experiencing night sweats for the past 3-4 days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I'm also having uh night sweats... been going on for last uh three four days, has it? Yeah, yes.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient had a fever initially which has been settling with Paracetamol and Ibuprofen.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I I had some some fever in the beginning, but it's now sort of uh going down. I I've been taking some Paracetamol and Ibuprofen for that

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports feeling short of breath (winded) on exertion but is fine at rest.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I feel a bit winded on exertion... When when when I'm resting it's OK.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies chest pain, ear pain, ear blockage, or ear discharge.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: no pain in chest... Any pain in, in your ears at all? Um no... No, you don't feel blocked, or any discharge coming out of your ears? No, I don't think so.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has intermittent, generalized headaches but no associated visual problems or photophobia.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: yeah, yeah. That that's still, that's still there... it's sort of general... every now and then they will come and go.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports general muscle and joint pain (myalgia) that started in the last couple of days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: any general muscle pain or aches, joint pain, ? Yeah, yeah. Yeah that's, that sort of started in the past couple days.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies nausea, vomiting, or skin rashes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: any feeling nausea or any vomiting? No, none of that... any funny rashes at all, on your skin? Um no, no.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Appetite is slightly reduced, but fluid intake has increased.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: How's your appetite, sir? Um maybe a bit less than uh than what I, I would usually have... I've been drinking a lot more than the usual.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient is otherwise fit and well with no other medical problems.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: are you otherwise fit and well? Or do you have any other medical problems... I'm I'm fine.

Medications.content: Patient is not taking any regular medications.
Medications.source_text: there isn't anything that I'm taking or, I'm being treated for.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: Patient has no known allergies to medications.
Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: any, any allergies at all to any medications, I should be aware of? Um, no

Family_History.source_text: my grandma has diabetes... I think it's type two.
one of my uh, great grandads had an eczema.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives alone and works as an accountant.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I live alone... I'm an, I'm an accountant.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient smokes cigars occasionally at company parties but is not a regular smoker.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: yeah occasionally, you know, cigars and things on company parties.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient drinks alcohol occasionally and is not a big drinker.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: occasionally yeah I would have some. I'm, I'm not a very big drinker.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Work is currently stressful due to year-end, but patient describes it as 'good stress' and denies any negative impact on mood.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: it's a bit of a stressful period just around the um, end of the year... it's the good kind of stress.

Assessment.content: The impression is a viral illness, likely an upper respiratory tract infection (URTI) or early influenza.
Assessment.source_text: I think you probably have, you know a bit of a viral, what we say viral illness, maybe a viral upper respiratory tract infection, or maybe early signs of a flu.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised conservative management including rest (1-2 days off work), increased fluid intake, and continued use of Paracetamol/Ibuprofen.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: get plenty of rest. I'd probably advise you taking a day or two off work... pushing fluids and make yourself well-hydrated. Continue with the regular Paracetamol, Ibuprofen.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to return for review next week (or in 5-7 days) if not better.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if next week you're still not better, I'd like you to come back and see me.

Follow_up_Information.content: Advised to seek urgent review sooner if developing high fever, labored breathing (SOB), or chest pain.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: things to look out for... if you have a high fever, or your breathing is becoming a bit more labored, or chest pain, I'd like you to come back and see me much sooner
